narrative: On the board. The morning's leaf is open on your knee, the fire on the ink. The two cups are still on the oak. A damp sleeve rests at the edge of the settle. The page is not a title page. On the board. Lower on the leaf. The question stands. The blank under it is still blank in the firelight. Nothing has been added since morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the leaf open and did not write on it.
